arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player, action limit1000, reply-search self-play root256/slate8/opponent64

data.export: Opt-in exact intermediate pre-action BatchObservations and locally indexed searched opponent actions, replayed from already searched plans with no new search. Also export full opponent plans to verify trace alignment.

measurements: Count terminal root candidates with empty opponent plans. On every nonterminal candidate and every recorded opponent decision, report policy top-one/top-three searched-action agreement, mean searched-action probability, by root seat, selected versus unselected root candidate, beneficial alternative versus all, action kind, and decision depth. Count full teacher-forced plans for which argmax matches every action and first divergence depth. Record exact denominators, map count, completed versus truncated maps, wall time and gzip hash. These are correlated candidate observations, not independent games.
interpretation: Teacher-forced whole-plan agreement is not autonomous rollout agreement: after a mismatch, the model would reach a different state. No policy strength, Elo, or deployment claim. If later actions are the main error, collect a training trajectory dataset and compare structured plan imitation on disjoint maps; do not reuse this diagnostic seed for validation.
